agent_priors_used: AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a comparator arm that silently accumulates state within an episode can reach a 1.0 ceiling even when it has no cross-episode memory, so an inheritance treatment's measured advantage over a 'memoryless' comparator is an upper bound and can be an artifact of comparator construction. This is why the safety of the SBA bank for the real four-arm benchmark must be re-tested with memoryful comparators before it is trusted.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): control-plane and instrument defects (non-executable frozen entry points, freeze-identity/hash mismatches, censored sampling frames) recur across research lanes and are best repaired once at the substrate/design-contract level rather than rediscovered lane-by-lane as a new MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This motivates embedding an instrument smoke-test as a pre-freeze gate in the Frontier re-design instead of trusting another narrative.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): when a bounded experiment's success, failure and invalidity branches would all leave every downstream architectural and product choice unchanged, running it is pure cost. This is why Product is parked on dependencies instead of being given a low-marginal-value refinement (delta-repair contamination, shipped-carrier re-verification) whose result would not change the flagship decision.

AGENT PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a single-vantage persistence result has low external validity; environmental factors (egress IP/ASN, geography, time-of-day throttling) are the usual confound for any measured stationarity, so a cross-vantage agreement test is the load-bearing reproducibility check for an access-barrier claim.

The artifact index yields 'discovery' path shas (e.g. 64a77a94cfbc413613815414a5070ad80357de8e) but these are navigation metadata only, so I do not treat them as a matched result; the compact brief is the binding screen and encodes the guard 'distinct observables may warrant new experiments' (P2-WP003B). allocation.question: Under a NEW, strictly bounded re-design that must FIRST prove its instrument and its substrate before any outcome is measured: on the credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP substrate, (precondition PC-1) smoke-test the exact frozen discovery entry point (--stage discovery / --stage all) to mechanical completion before freeze and bind the executed code identity so a v2 freeze-eligibility check cannot again pass on a non-executable measured object; (precondition PC-2) freeze a census that separates DEEP-discovered from DEEP-fetched, with observed controls, and sample the unfetched deep frontiers (mdBook/doc.rust-lang.org, docs.pytest.org, quotes.toscrape.com, pandas.pydata.org hop>=3 pages) so Q1 measures state-carrying prevalence rather than crawl observability under an item-blind BFS budget; and (PC-3) require at least two distinct hosts/engines on which DEEP state-carrying items are actually observable, because the frozen 20-host pool showed only Sphinx-RTD observable (32/196 deep pages with controls) so the >=2-engine contrast was never demonstrated reachable. ONLY if PC-1..PC-3 hold may the packet measure: (Q2) the discovery-reachable fraction of DEEP state-carrying items in <= K=3 fresh-agent GETs via the five frozen site-native discovery channels (ROBOTS_SITEMAP, SITEMAP_XML, ON_SITE_SEARCH, RSS_ATOM, JSON_LD), with per-channel coverage disclosed, and (Q3) whether that fraction is >= 0.50 on at least two distinct engines. If PC-1, PC-2 or PC-3 cannot be satisfied at pre-freeze cost, the design must fail loudly and record BLOCKED with the exact unmet precondition instead of freezing a weaker run; in that case this bounded thread is TERMINATED.
allocation.rationale: CONTINUE uses the parent handoff but converts it into a hard-gated re-design rather than a fourth blind attempt, because the prior two packets in this family never produced a valid measurement for instrument reasons and not because the mechanism was refuted: EXP-FRONTIER-37984242167 was BLOCKED (empty sampling frame, 0 seeds/0 hosts) and EXP-FRONTIER-38164611798 was MEASUREMENT_INVALID (frozen outcome code TypeError on controls_seen, item-blind BFS-budget censoring of the Q1 census, per-engine metric inconsistency and a freeze-identity mismatch). Decision counterfactual: a valid Q2/Q3 result (site-native discovery reaches DEEP state items in <=3 GETs on >=2 engines) licenses a concrete, cheap exploration prior that could materially reduce agent search; a valid negative closes site-native discovery as a route for deep credential-free items; and a BLOCKED-on-precondition receipt closes the factory's ability to test this on the credential-free substrate. All three branches change the exploration-strategy decision, so one bounded, requirement-gated attempt is justified -- but only one. Strongest fair baseline: the unconditional same-host BFS that already reaches the same items at hop cost, plus per-channel nulls reported as zero-coverage rather than as successes. Smallest decisive batch / stop: a single pre-freeze attainability+instrument probe, then at most one frozen census; PC-3 failure terminates the thread. cognitive_reset=true (Frontier idle, and site-native discovery is arguably a conventional crawling mechanism rather than an out-of-basin architecture): I performed the reset and still chose this question, because the alternative high-upside representation test (flat cache / nearest-neighbour / procedural lookup vs fractal-nav + macro composition) is a work-compression economics question whose readiness gating (C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY is explicitly gated) is not satisfied this cycle, whereas the deep-reachability question is bounded, credential-free, and tests a real exploration-reduction mechanism that has never been validly measured. I note the mission tension explicitly: this is the last attempt before Frontier should be redirected to a genuinely orthogonal mechanism.

The program's bottleneck is unchanged and is not a shortage of experiments: the one decisive external-agent result (four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER cost per successful task) has never been produced, and it is gated on three readiness conditions. Condition (1) was just discharged: EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 installed the audited parameterized carrier byte-identically (git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) with a PASS D0-D4+V8 certificate. Condition (3) is open: the credential-free local 3B-8B Qwen class failed the minimal multi-step Web-agent bar (EXP-INTEL-38164607941, FALSIFY), and the frozen Intel experiment to provision a capable endpoint or record the exact blocker is not yet complete. There are three in-flight transactions (graph FROZEN resolver/ambiguity-gate, intel FROZEN endpoint, runtime PREFREEZE memoryful-comparator, physics PREFREEZE second-vantage) and two idle lanes (Product, Frontier). This cycle therefore (a) completes the four in-flight transactions because already-frozen/pre-freeze work under a still-correct mandate is finished before redirection, (b) explicitly PARks Product on the two named dependencies rather than letting an idle lane drift, and (c) spends the one genuinely open exploratory slot (Frontier) on a bounded, hard-stopped re-design of the never-validly-measured deep-state reachability question.
